provenance: Synthetic: a new option must not change the default output that another module and its protected tests depend on. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Let formatBytes use decimal units on request
task.description: Add an optional second argument to `formatBytes(n, options)` in `src/format-bytes.mjs`: `{ base }` where `base` is `1024` (binary, the default) or `1000` (SI). With `base: 1000`, 1 KB is 1000 B, 1 MB is 1000 KB and so on. Calls that omit the option must produce exactly today's output, because `src/report.mjs` and its tests depend on it.
steps: Add the base option to src/format-bytes.mjs
Add tests for base 1000 in test/format-bytes-si.test.mjs
